title: Foundations to advanced tutorial
text: following script intentionally compact. suitable first file new user creates installing mixRSMflow.
code: library(mixRSMflow)  # 1. Inspect package capabilities. mix_capabilities()  # 2. Define the mixture space. sp <- mix_spec(   components = c("A", "B", "C"),   lower = c(0.05, 0.05, 0.05),   upper = c(0.90, 0.90, 0.90) )  # 3. Inspect the feasible vertices. mix_vertices(sp)  # 4. Generate a classical design. des <- mix_design(   sp,   type = "augmented_centroid",   seed = 20260813 )  print(des) mix_plot(des)  # 5. Evaluate the design for the intended model. dev <- mix_design_eval(   des,   model = "scheffe_quadratic",   resolution = 15 )  print(dev) mix_plot(dev, "fds")  # 6. Load reproducible teaching data. dat <- mix_demo_data(   "mixture",   n_rep = 3,   seed = 20260813 )  # 7. Fit a Scheffé quadratic surface. fit <- mix_fit(   response = "response",   data = dat,   spec = sp,   model = "scheffe_quadratic" )  summary(fit)  # 8. Check pure error and lack of fit. mix_anova(fit)  # 9. Diagnose the fitted surface. diag <- mix_diagnose(fit) print(diag)  mix_collinearity(fit)  mix_plot(   fit,   type = "residuals" )  # 10. Interpret one component through a feasible path. eff <- mix_effects(   fit,   type = "cox",   component = "A",   n = 51 )  print(eff) mix_plot(eff)  # 11. Display the fitted response surface. mix_plot(   fit,   type = "ternary_contour",   resolution = 40 )  # 12. Find the bounded optimum. opt <- mix_optimize(   fit,   goal = "maximize",   method = "hybrid",   grid_resolution = 30,   random_candidates = 5000,   seed = 20260813 )  print(opt) mix_plot(opt)  # 13. Quantify uncertainty in optimum location. ci <- mix_optimum_ci(   opt,   method = "parametric",   B = 500,   level = 0.95,   grid_resolution = 20,   seed = 20260814 )  print(ci) mix_plot(ci)  # 14. Generate an auditable report. mix_report(   list(     fit = fit,     design = des,     optimum = opt   ),   file = "starter_mixRSMflow_report.md",   format = "markdown",   title = "Starter mixRSMflow analysis" )  # 15. Preserve the recorded workflow decisions. mix_audit_trail(fit)

title: mixRSMflow 0.1.0.9000
text: Initial development source snapshot. Added bounded mixture specification, general linear restrictions, L/U pseudocomponents, extreme-vertex enumeration, independent-coordinate regions. Added simplex-lattice, simplex-centroid, axial, augmented, symmetric-simplex, extreme-vertices, multiple-lattice, categorized-component, mixture-process, mixture-amount, split-plot, blocked, Latin-square process design constructors. Added Scheffe linear quartic families plus slack-variable, inverse, ratio, Cox, log-contrast, Becker/general-blending, additive-blending, Kronecker bases. Added Gaussian/GLM fits optional GLS, mixed-effects, Bayesian backends. Added lack--fit/pure-error decomposition, collinearity diagnostics, hierarchical model reduction, component screening, Cox/Piepel effects, segmented fits. Added D///G/E/T/Alias/Bayesian optimal-design criteria, model-robust aggregation, exchange/GA/hybrid search, FDS, VDG, rotatability diagnostics, sequential augmentation. Added constrained optimization, GA search, optimum-location uncertainty, near-optimal regions, desirability, response constraints, Pareto approximation, biplots, optional GP Bayesian optimization. Added publication-oriented vector 3D mixture surfaces, ternary contours, Plotly backends, reporting, Shiny teaching interface, simulated datasets, capability registry.

title: mixRSMflow 0.1.0.9000
text: Single-row ratio, Cox, log-contrast, inverse bases previously failed dimnames mismatch; now build correct column shape number rows. mixture-process basis (mixture_process = TRUE) generated component--process cross terms, collinear process main effects components sum one; cross terms now omit constant columns last component’s main effect declared model estimable. mix_design_eval() now returns prediction_variance numeric vector instead data frame. mixture-specification centre now corrected sum exactly mixture total; mix_transform()/mix_inverse_transform() round trips exact machine precision instead inheriting ~1e-8 bisection tolerance. mix_augment() longer fails rbind column mismatch parent design carries auxiliary .run column; alignment bug mix_bo() sequential-objective path fixed padding new rows observation table’s columns. mix_augment() also gained candidates argument, /G objectives precompute evaluation-grid basis instead rebuilding every candidate. mix_optimum_ci() now optimizes declared grid instead adding five thousand random candidates per call, samples 1000-point uncertainty cloud, warns successful replicates fewer 20% succeed. mix_fit_bayes() now defaults brms::brmsfamily("gaussian") instead unexported brms::gaussian, removing R CMD check dependency warning. mixture-process vignette now declares process_order = 1 two-level process factors: quadratic process model rank deficient crossed design, vignette explains . Shiny interface longer embeds non-ASCII arrow characters, keeping R code files portable ASCII. inst/scripts/validate_local.R sets R_LIBS_USER Sys.setenv() running frozen battery: system2(env = ...) entries reliably promoted child environment variables Windows, made battery fail locate freshly installed build. Vignette files renamed NN-*.Rmd vNN-*.Rmd R CMD check requires vignette file names start letter. S3 method help pages now use \method{generic}{class} markup \usage sections, ... arguments documented. Every exported function now least three usage examples manual page least three executed calls across vignettes (runtime- verified example index added validation vignette). maintainer placeholder replaced real author contact DESCRIPTION.
